snippet.title: Rusty Rangers | Summer Next Fest Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Rusty Rangers is a roguelite platformer with Metroidvania elements. It offers fast-paced action inspired by Dead Cells and Enter the Gungeon, wrapped in retro pixel art aesthetics and high replayability. Explore procedurally generated levels, collect unique items to create powerful builds, battle bosses, and develop your base between runs. Choose your Ranger and hunt down the treacherous Baron in a world plunged into chaos!

Developed by independent studio Fantastica!, Rusty Rangers launches on consoles (Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 4/5) on June 21, 2025, followed by its PC (Steam, Steam Deck) release on July 31, 2025. An updated demo is available now during Steam Next Fest.

Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/1599420/Rusty_Rangers/
